# miniaudio 0.11.22, vendored

The desktop build's audio: one header that opens an output and an input on
whatever the machine has - PulseAudio first on Linux (which PipeWire also
answers to), then ALSA, then JACK. It stands in for Oboe, which is Android's.
The phone build does not include it.

    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mackron/miniaudio/0.11.22/miniaudio.h
